title: Tell a Classmate About Your Study Item

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构草稿；未启用，尚待独立语义与发音审核。

instructions: 先准备关键词，再尝试用自己的短句说；音频评测需要真实录音及服务结果。
prompt: Speak in short sentences, using 70–100 words. Say your name, describe one study item, and give a polite instruction. Use at least six lesson words.
guidance: 先说 My name is ...；指一件物品说 This is my ...；用 Please ... 给一句礼貌指令；最后说你能怎样帮助对方。可先分段练习短句，再连起来尝试自己的话。
reference: My name is Ava. I am a student in an English group. This is my notebook. It has a short note. I write my name in it. I have a textbook too. Please open your book, Tom. We can read one name together. A sound is not clear? Please ask me. I can speak again and help you spell it. Then we can check our work with the teacher. Thank you for your help.
referenceLabel: 原创 AI 示例，仅供学习。

oralModelAudio.text: My name is Ava. I am a student in an English group. This is my notebook. It has a short note. I write my name in it. I have a textbook too. Please open your book, Tom. We can read one name together. A sound is not clear? Please ask me. I can speak again and help you spell it.
Then we can check our work with the teacher. Thank you for your help.
